services.name: Roof Repair
services.tagline: Fast, reliable roof repairs you can count on
services.description: We fix leaks, storm damage, missing shingles, and all types of roof repairs — quickly and professionally.
outcomes: Peace of mind for your family and property

problem_frames.leak: A leaking roof can cause serious damage to your home if left untreated. We can usually get someone out within 24–48 hours to assess and fix it.
problem_frames.storm_damage: Storm damage needs to be addressed quickly before it gets worse. We handle insurance paperwork too, so you don't have to stress about it.
problem_frames.default: Roof problems only get more expensive the longer you wait. Let's get it looked at and give you an honest assessment.

services.name: New Roof Installation
services.tagline: Quality roof installations built to last
services.description: Full roof replacement and new construction roofing — using premium materials with industry-leading warranties.
outcomes: A brand-new roof with a 25+ year warranty
Complete protection for your biggest investment

problem_frames.old_roof: If your roof is over 20 years old, it's likely past its prime. A new roof not only protects your home but can increase its value by 15–40%.
problem_frames.new_construction: For new builds, getting the roof right from the start saves thousands in the long run. We use premium materials that last.
problem_frames.default: A new roof is one of the best investments you can make in your property. We make the process simple and stress-free.

faqs.question: How much does a roof repair cost?
faqs.answer: Repair costs vary based on the type and extent of damage. Minor repairs typically start around $300–$500, while larger repairs can range from $1,000–$3,000. We offer free inspections to give you an accurate estimate.

faqs.question: How long does a roof replacement take?
faqs.answer: Most residential roof replacements are completed in 1–3 days, depending on the size of your home and weather conditions.

faqs.question: Do you handle insurance claims?
faqs.answer: Yes! We work directly with insurance companies and can help you with the claims process from start to finish.
